title: Transcription engine
description: Which engine transcribes each kind of meeting, and whether a Virtual Participant separates the voices behind one attendee.
appliesText: A saved change applies to meetings that start at least 30 seconds after the save; a meeting already running keeps its settings.

streamingEngineMicrovm.title: Stream Audio, Chrome extension and Desktop Capture
streamingEngineMicrovm.description: Speaker identification per channel is chosen per meeting, on the Stream Audio form or in the desktop app's settings.

virtualParticipantEngineMicrovm.title: Virtual Participants
virtualParticipantEngineMicrovm.description: Speaker names come from the meeting roster with either engine.

diarizeVirtualParticipant.title: Virtual Participant voice separation
diarizeVirtualParticipant.description: When one attendee is several people, such as a conference room, label their voices "Name (spk_0)", "Name (spk_1)". Works with either engine: on Amazon Transcribe from its own speaker labels, and on the on-demand engine where its model bundle has speaker identification; with a bundle that has none, the on-demand engine labels by roster name only.
